description: Nine-case common-seed confirmation of the equal-third T–J–S baseline, the Round 07 urgency hold-Throughput balanced candidate, and the deficit group Throughput+Service delay candidate. This round tests repeatability only; it does not add new reward components or tune PPO.

common.reward_normalization: All three profiles use positive_scale=1.0, normalized positive weights, no delta reward, no explicit penalty, no Lagrangian training, no rule, no candidate filter and no forced HARQ selection. Each profile is trained and validated on the same three common seeds: 1701, 2701 and 3701.

analysis.title: Round 08 — Xác nhận đa seed cho Urgency và Deficit

profile_labels.urgency_hold_throughput: Ứng viên cân bằng: Urgency hold-Throughput
profile_labels.deficit_group_ts: Ứng viên delay: Deficit giữ nhóm T+S

profile_roles.tjs_equal: Mốc chuẩn đã ổn định từ Round 04–07; dùng để kiểm tra reward thứ tư có tạo lợi ích lặp lại hay không.
profile_roles.urgency_hold_throughput: Ứng viên số 1 từ Round 07; kiểm tra fairness tăng lặp lại mà vẫn giữ goodput, zero-starvation và tail delay.
profile_roles.deficit_group_ts: Ứng viên số 2 từ Round 07; kiểm tra tail delay giảm lặp lại và định lượng mức đánh đổi goodput.

decision_rules.urgency_keep: Stable at all three seeds, repeated Jain improvement versus paired T–J–S seeds, zero starvation, and mean goodput no lower than 98% of baseline.
decision_rules.deficit_keep: Stable at all three seeds with repeated P99/max-wait improvement; retain as delay-sensitive profile only if the observed goodput trade-off is acceptable.
decision_rules.reject_candidates: If neither candidate is stable at all three seeds or improvements do not repeat, return to equal-third T–J–S.
